button.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button with multiple variants, sizes, and states.
button.variantsDesc: Use the variant prop to change the visual hierarchy.
button.sizesDesc: Available in standardized sizes: xs, sm, default, lg, and icon variants.
button.statesDesc: Buttons handle loading, pressed, and disabled states automatically, preserving width and blocking pointer events.
button.groupDesc: Group related buttons cohesively with ButtonGroup, and enrich buttons with leading or trailing icons.

badge.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge to highlight status, tags, and counts.
badge.overviewDesc: Adjust variant, size, and interactive status options in real time with synchronized previews for Web and Desktop.
badge.variantsDesc: All six standard semantic variants aligned with the ChaSet design token system.
badge.sizesDesc: Choose between standard pill scale (default) and compact micro badge (sm).
badge.statusDesc: Badges support live status indicator dots and dismissible action buttons for filter tags.

label.description: Renders an accessible label associated with form controls.
label.overviewDesc: Adjust size, required markers, optional indicators, validation states, and disabled appearance in real time.
label.sizesDesc: Choose between standard text size and compact high-density size for dense layouts.
label.statesDesc: Visual matrix of label states including required asterisk, optional tag, validation error, helper description, and tooltips.
label.requiredDesc: Destructive asterisk denoting mandatory input fields
label.optionalDesc: Muted tag denoting non-mandatory optional fields
label.invalidDesc: Destructive text color highlighting validation error
label.tooltipDesc: Help icon with contextual explanation on hover
label.recoveryTooltip: Used for two-factor authentication recovery codes
label.descriptionDesc: Supporting guidance subtitle directly below label
label.legalEntityHelper: Enter your official company legal name
label.disabledDesc: Dimmed opacity for non-interactive form elements
label.formControlDesc: Clicking the label activates or toggles the linked input element via htmlFor.
label.termsSubtitle: Click the text below to toggle the checkbox
label.acceptTerms: I accept the terms and conditions

separator.description: Visually or semantically separates content in a list, form, or section.
separator.overviewDesc: Test orientation, dashed/dotted line styles, and labeled section dividers across Web and Desktop.
separator.systemDesc: Cross-stack React & Qt Quick Design System.
separator.examplesDesc: Common layout patterns using horizontal, vertical, dashed, dotted, and labeled separators.
separator.accountDesc: Manage your workspace settings and profile.
separator.labeledDividersDesc: Embed clear section titles or auth splits with left, center, or right alignment.
separator.borderStylesDesc: Choose between solid, dashed, or dotted dividers to distinguish hierarchy.
separator.navDividerDesc: Vertical dividers between inline list items or metadata tags.

skeleton.description: Used to show a placeholder while content is loading, with smooth CSS pulse and wave shimmer animations.
skeleton.overviewDesc: Visual placeholder skeleton cards for progressive loading states. Switch between pulse, wave shimmer, or static modes.

copy-button.description: One-click clipboard copy button with transient success checkmark feedback and customizable timeout.
copy-button.overviewDesc: Click either copy button below to copy the target string to your system clipboard.
copy-button.clickToTest: Click the copy button to test

split-button.description: Dual-action button with primary direct click and secondary attached dropdown menu.
split-button.overviewDesc: Click the main button to trigger the primary action, or click the chevron to open the dropdown menu.

elided-text.description: Smart text truncation with automatic overflow detection, click-to-copy, and contextual tooltip reveal.
elided-text.overviewDesc: Resize the container below using the slider. When the text is clipped with an ellipsis, hovering reveals the full path in a tooltip. Click to copy the full path when copyable is enabled.
elided-text.multiLineDesc: Using maxLines={2}, text wraps up to two lines before truncating with an ellipsis.
elided-text.sampleParagraph: ChaSet provides cross-stack design system primitives with pixel-level parity across React Web and Qt Quick desktop applications.

kbd.description: Displays keyboard shortcuts, key combinations, and keycap badges with smart compact truncation.
kbd.overviewDesc: Adjust variant, size, and compact symbol mode in real time with synchronized previews for Web and Desktop.
kbd.variantsDesc: Four distinct visual styles designed for menus, search fields, dialogs, and inverted tooltips.

squircle.description: iOS continuous curvature superellipse rounded corners (G2 continuity). Eliminates harsh creases caused by abrupt curvature transitions in classic circular arcs, providing smooth, organic modern corners across the design system.
